content: **Winkelmann MSR Technology** GmbH, based in Ahlen (Germany), **STÖHR ARMATUREN** GmbH & Co. Ltd. After all, we have decades of experience and know-how born of our passion for the production of complex formed products made from a diverse range of materials! And that’s why Winkelmann Flowforming is part of a global family business that was founded in 1898. Today, Winkelmann Group GmbH & Co. KG with its three divisions — Automotive, Building + Industry, and Flowforming — is one of the leaders in the field of metal forming in a wide range of industrial sectors. And we, at Winkelmann Flowforming, are a proud and ambitious part of the group. In addition to Ahlen and Auburn, we now have a third location in northeastern Turkey: Ergene in the province of Tekirdağ.
